recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO wants to revisit the singular element name, child optionality, or BackboneElement shape, open a new work-group decision because current R6 source and FHIR-54623 support leaving the model unchanged.
issue_request: FHIR-18838 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested support for instructional material by replacing the old single ServiceRequest.patientInstruction string with repeatable patient instructions that could carry markdown or a DocumentReference reference.
initial_application: The PR #2600 history applied the request before this reconciliation: 54d590c first introduced a plural repeating markdown-or-DocumentReference choice, 9a3eca changed it to a repeating BackboneElement with an instructions[x] child, and a056425 normalized the names to the current ServiceRequest.patientInstruction and ServiceRequest.patientInstruction.instruction[x]. The Jira application comment points to merge/application commit 82a5e11548ca38466674c55e3f4dcfd39f533d46.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has ServiceRequest.patientInstruction 0..* BackboneElement and ServiceRequest.patientInstruction.instruction[x] 0..1 markdown or Reference(DocumentReference), and the example uses that structure. Later issue FHIR-54623 directly challenged the BackboneElement/single-child shape and was Resolved - No Change, saying the choice element must be a child to allow multiple patient instructions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source preserves the implementer-significant outcome of FHIR-18838: multiple patient/consumer instructions can be represented, and each instruction can be markdown or a DocumentReference. Renaming the element back to the plural Jira wording or flattening it to a direct choice would now be a new breaking model change and would conflict with the later no-change decision.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 Resolved - No Change issue rejected simplifying ServiceRequest.patientInstruction back to a direct choice and supports the current BackboneElement-with-child-choice model.
